cohort: 30 newborns (age range 2-26 days) with SMA and 16 neonates without SMA from 6 German neuromuscular centers.
finding: Newborns with and without SMA had higher hs-cTnI plasma levels compared to assay-specific reference values generated in adults.
mod_finding: No relevant correlation was found between mode of delivery and hs-cTnI levels in newborns with SMA.
